title: Did a Wine Importer Just Sink Trump’s Trade War?

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最出色的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢单锅菜谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特惠，网址为 nytimes.com 后面加 slash 接着 subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的雷切尔·阿布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In a blow that has threatened to derail President Trump's trade agenda, a federal court ruled on Wednesday that many of the president's tariffs are in fact illegal.
sentences.zh: 在一记可能导致特朗普总统贸易议程脱轨的重击之下，一家联邦法院周三裁定，总统实施的许多关税实际上是非法的。

sentences.en: That decision makes the future of Trump's trade war even more uncertain.
sentences.zh: 这项裁决让特朗普贸易战的未来变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Today, I talk to Victor Schwartz, the wine importer at the center of the case, about why he decided to take on the president.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将与本案核心人物、葡萄酒进口商维克托·施瓦茨对话，聊聊他为何决定向总统发起挑战。

sentences.en: And to my colleague Gina Smilich on Trump's options as he scrambles to keep his trade war alive.
sentences.zh: 还将与我的同事吉娜·斯米利希一起探讨特朗普在竭力维持贸易战时有哪些应对选项。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月30日，星期五。

sentences.en: Victor?
sentences.zh: 维克托？

sentences.en: Yes, hello.
sentences.zh: 对，你好。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Rachel Abrams from The Daily.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是《每日新闻》的雷切尔·阿布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm just crazy.
sentences.zh: 我简直快疯了。

sentences.en: You're having quite the day.
sentences.zh: 你今天可真够忙的。

sentences.en: It has just been nonstop.
sentences.zh: 简直一刻没停过。

sentences.en: I got a call from ABC News in the middle of dinner.
sentences.zh: 我正吃着晚饭呢，就接到了美国广播公司的电话。

sentences.en: They wanted to come over to my place, which kind of got me nervous because I thought they were some weirdos.
sentences.zh: 他们想来我家，这让我有点紧张，因为我以为他们是什么怪人。

sentences.en: I grilled them a bit.
sentences.zh: 我盘问了他们一会儿。

sentences.en: I hope they're real.
sentences.zh: 但愿他们是真的。

sentences.en: I said, OK, well, meet me outside my building.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，那在大楼外面见我。

sentences.en: No, I'm not letting you in my house.
sentences.zh: 不，我可不放你进我家。

sentences.en: So that was fine.
sentences.zh: 所以就这样吧。

sentences.en: It was very nice people.
sentences.zh: 他们都是很好的人。

sentences.en: And then I got a call from CNN in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 接着我又接到了来自香港美国有线电视新闻网的电话。

sentences.en: So that was crazy.
sentences.zh: 所以真是疯了。

sentences.en: And then the phone's been ringing and everybody wants to get my comment.
sentences.zh: 然后电话就一直响个不停，每个人都想听听我的评论。

sentences.en: Obviously, the reason that you're getting hounded is that you were the lead plaintiff on a case that got ruled on Wednesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 显然，你之所以被人死缠烂打，是因为你是周三下午做出裁决的那起案件的首席原告。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So the ruling basically said, you know, much of Trump's tariffs are illegal.
sentences.zh: 所以这项裁决基本上是说，你懂的，特朗普的许多关税都是非法的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Can you just bring us to the moment where you found out about the court ruling?
sentences.zh: 你能带我们回到你得知法院裁决的那一刻吗？

sentences.en: How did you find out and how did you feel?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么知道的？当时有什么感受？

sentences.en: Well, I was literally preparing dinner.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时正准备做晚饭。

sentences.en: I was looking for a recipe for linguine and claMs.
sentences.zh: 我在找一道蛤蜊扁面条的食谱。

sentences.en: And I walked over the computer.
sentences.zh: 然后我走到电脑前。

sentences.en: You know, I'd looked at one before.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我之前看了一眼。

sentences.en: And then I got an email from Sarah Albrecht, who is the head of the Liberty Justice Center at the wonderful people who have taken our case pro bono.
sentences.zh: 接着我收到了萨拉·阿尔布雷克的电子邮件，她是自由正义中心的主任，正是这群好心人无偿接下了我们的案子。

sentences.en: And they're the ones doing the heavy lifting.
sentences.zh: 重活累活都是他们在干。

sentences.en: Not me.
sentences.zh: 可不是我。

sentences.en: I'm just the legal spokesmodel.
sentences.zh: 我只是个法律代言人。

sentences.en: So I read that.
sentences.zh: 所以我读了那封邮件。

sentences.en: And, of course, I'm completely confused because I don't know the legalese or the summary judgment.
sentences.zh: 当然，我完全一头雾水，因为我不懂法律术语或简易判决。

sentences.en: Is that good?
sentences.zh: 这是好事吗？

sentences.en: Bad?
sentences.zh: 坏事？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I immediately got in touch with a friend of mine who's a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我马上联系了我的一位律师朋友。

sentences.en: He explained it, that it was very good.
sentences.zh: 他给我解释了，说这是一件极好的事。

sentences.en: So I've just kind of been off to the races.
sentences.zh: 所以我就这样顺风顺水地忙起来了。

sentences.en: How did you become the spokesmodel for this lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么成为这起诉讼的代言人的？

sentences.en: Because I'll tell you, I'll tell you, it is also strange and backdoor.
sentences.zh: 因为我得告诉你，这事儿也挺奇怪，而且挺曲折的。

sentences.en: It's like unintentional.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是无心插柳。

sentences.en: This is in March.
sentences.zh: 那是三月份的时候。

sentences.en: We're at brunch.
sentences.zh: 我们在吃早午餐。

sentences.en: And we're talking about the tariffs because that was on everyone's mind.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论关税，因为那是每个人都在关心的事情。

sentences.en: And I was having a conversation with a cousin of my wife's.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在和我妻子的一位表亲聊天。

sentences.en: And he brought up the fact that his former law professor was bringing a case against the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他提到他的前法学教授正在提起一桩针对关税的诉讼。

sentences.en: And I said, wow, this is great because I wanted to give my two cents about what was going on in my business, in the wine business.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇，这太棒了，因为我想就我自己的生意——葡萄酒生意里正在发生的事情发表点看法。

sentences.en: You know, I got in touch with him right away and he got right back to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我马上就联系了他，他也很快回复了我。

sentences.en: He got right back to me.
sentences.zh: 他立刻就回了我电话。

sentences.en: And we had a wonderful conversation.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次非常愉快的交谈。

sentences.en: I told him my tales of woe about being in the wine business and an importer in the world of threatened tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我向他倾诉了我在葡萄酒行业、在面临关税威胁的世界里当进口商的苦水。

sentences.en: And he said, OK, fine.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，好吧，行。

sentences.en: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: And then three days later, they asked if I would be the lead plaintiff.
sentences.zh: 接着三天后，他们问我愿不愿意当首席原告。

sentences.en: And that's when I got nervous.
sentences.zh: 也就是那时候我开始紧张了。

sentences.en: Well, what does that entail?
sentences.zh: 嗯，那意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Let me talk to my wife and kids.
sentences.zh: 让我跟妻子和孩子商量一下。

sentences.en: And, of course, they were all kind of nervous because the administration is known for being vengeful.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们其实都挺紧张的，因为现政府一向以记仇闻名。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're a heavily regulated business.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，我们是一个受到高度监管的行业。

sentences.en: We have a lot of business in front of the government, whether it's importation, FDA rules, et cetera, et cetera, et cetera, label requirements.
sentences.zh: 我们在政府面前有大量的业务往来，无论是进口、食药监局规定，还是林林总总的其他规定、标签要求等等。

sentences.en: So it's like, well, should I do this?
sentences.zh: 所以当时就在想，我该做这事吗？

sentences.en: Should I not?
sentences.zh: 还是不作？

sentences.en: You know, I don't really want to stick my neck out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我其实不想出头露面。

sentences.en: And then I thought about all the billionaires that I'm just so pissed off about doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 然后我想到了那些袖手旁观、让我极其恼火的亿万富翁们。

sentences.en: And I'm going, we're all sitting around.
sentences.zh: 我在想，我们都在那儿闲坐着。

sentences.en: We're all complaining.
sentences.zh: 我们都在抱怨。

sentences.en: We're all saying, hey, what can we do about this?
sentences.zh: 我们都在说，嘿，我们能对此做些什么呢？

sentences.en: You know, what can I do?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我能做点什么？

sentences.en: Everyone's feeling powerless.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得无能为力。

sentences.en: And I said, this just landed on my plate.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，这事儿偏偏落到了我的头上。

sentences.en: If I don't step up, then how can I expect anybody else to?
sentences.zh: 如果我都不站出来，那我怎么能指望别人去站出来呢？

sentences.en: And I just felt it was incumbent upon me to do it and let the chips fall where they may.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我有责任这么做，至于结果如何，那就听天由命吧。

sentences.en: You describe this as a tale of woe for a wine importer.
sentences.zh: 你把这形容为葡萄酒进口商的苦水经。

sentences.en: I want to understand that better.
sentences.zh: 我想更深入地了解一下。

sentences.en: A tale of woe, yes.
sentences.zh: 苦水经，是的。

sentences.en: Tell us the tale of woe.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这本苦水经吧。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, understand, you know, number one, we're a very heavily regulated business.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先得明白，第一，我们是一个受到高度监管的行业。

sentences.en: So, for instance, we have to post our prices, our discounts, fixed with the state over a month in advance before we start selling.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，我们必须在开始销售前一个多月，向州里报备我们的价格、折扣，并且是固定下来的。

sentences.en: And we can't change them.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不能更改。

sentences.en: So, if, like, I've got a five-case price, $120 a case or something like that, I can't say, oh, it's a tariff.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果比如我有一个五箱起批的价格，每箱120美元左右，我可不能说，哦，因为有关于关税的事。

sentences.en: I'm going to change that to $150.
sentences.zh: 我要把它改成150美元。

sentences.en: It's done.
sentences.zh: 这已经定型了。

sentences.en: It's fixed.
sentences.zh: 它是固定的。

sentences.en: So, the tariff liberation, quote, unquote, liberation day, I call it strangulation day.
sentences.zh: 所以，所谓的关税解放日——加引号的解放日，我管它叫窒息日。

sentences.en: So, we had to really jump on this right away and try to make some decisions in a very unclear situation.
sentences.zh: 因此，在局势极其不明朗的情况下，我们必须立刻采取行动，试图做出一些决定。

sentences.en: So, there's that.
sentences.zh: 所以，情况就是这样。

sentences.en: Plus, where is the tariff money going to come from?
sentences.zh: 另外，关税的钱要从哪里来？

sentences.en: Those tariffs have to be paid up front.
sentences.zh: 那些关税必须提前支付。

sentences.en: This is, as I put it, it's worse than a tax because a tax usually happens after the event.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，这比税收还要糟糕，因为税收通常发生在事件发生之后。

sentences.en: This happens before anything, before we sold a bottle.
sentences.zh: 而这发生在任何事情之前，在我们卖出一瓶酒之前。

sentences.en: So, even if our commander-in-chief says, it's not a big deal, just raise your prices.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使我们的三军统帅说，这没什么大不了的，提高你们的售价不就行了嘛。

sentences.en: If I raise the price on a container, I don't see the revenue from that container for months down the road.
sentences.zh: 如果我提高一个集装箱的售价，在接下来的好几个月里我都收不到那个集装箱的收入。

sentences.en: We have to sell it all.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把酒全卖出去。

sentences.en: We have to collect it all.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把钱全收回来。

sentences.en: You know, so where is that capital going to come from?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那笔资金要从哪里来呢？

sentences.en: It's a real cash flow killer.
sentences.zh: 这简直是现金流的杀手。

sentences.en: That's the real challenge.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的挑战。

sentences.en: And when you're a small business, cash flow is always a challenge.
sentences.zh: 当你是一家小企业时，现金流永远是一个挑战。

sentences.en: So, bottom line is, you import wine.
sentences.zh: 所以，归根结底，你进口葡萄酒。

sentences.en: That costs money.
sentences.zh: 那是要花钱的。

sentences.en: It's already cost you money.
sentences.zh: 它已经让你花过钱了。

sentences.en: You decided to fight this.
sentences.zh: 你决定与之抗争。

sentences.en: I decided I had to step up.
sentences.zh: 我决定我必须站出来。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it came to me in a sense.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，某种程度上它是自己找上门来的。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: It wasn't like I was looking for a law case.
sentences.zh: 并不是我在主动寻找官司打。

sentences.en: I want to be very clear about that.
sentences.zh: 这一点我想说得非常清楚。

sentences.en: How did you feel when you won yesterday?
sentences.zh: 昨天赢了的时候你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Because I got to point out here, you're literally going up against the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 因为我必须在这里指出，你对抗的可是名副其实的美国总统。

sentences.en: You presumably know how much this policy means to him.
sentences.zh: 你大概也知道这项政策对他有多重要。

sentences.en: And you just threw a gigantic wrench into his whole plan.
sentences.zh: 而你却给他的整个计划狠狠泼了一盆冷水。

sentences.en: I mean, when I first read the complaint, VOS Elections, Inc.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我第一次读到这份起诉书时，即“VOS精选公司诉特朗普等一案”，

sentences.en: versus Trump et al., I laughed like a lunatic.
sentences.zh: 我像个疯子一样大笑起来。

sentences.en: I mean, in a sense, like, this is so crazy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种意义上说，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This is not what I signed up for when I created my company 39 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这可不是我39年前创立公司时的初衷。

sentences.en: You know, I just wanted to find interesting wines that are really delicious, find a community of like-minded people on this side of the pond,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我只是想寻找真正美味的有趣葡萄酒，在大西洋这一边寻找一个志同道合的社群，

sentences.en: and sell them these delicious wines and have a happy life.
sentences.zh: 把这些美酒卖给他们，过上幸福的生活。

sentences.en: You know, that's all I wanted to do and not pay high tariffs for it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就是我唯一想做的事，而且为此不用支付高昂的关税。

sentences.en: I am sure there are definitely some trade issues.
sentences.zh: 我确信肯定存在一些贸易问题。

sentences.en: I'm not, like, completely anti-tariff in some way.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说在某种程度上完全反感关税。

sentences.en: But the fact is, it was not necessary for our industry, and certainly not across the board.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这对我们行业来说完全没有必要，更不用说全面加征了。

sentences.en: Do you feel any certainty now about what to do with your business?
sentences.zh: 你现在对该如何处理你的生意有一点确定感了吗？

sentences.en: Like, will this actually help the plant?
sentences.zh: 比如，这真的能帮到这家工厂吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Like, don't count your chickens yet.
sentences.zh: 就像别高兴得太早一样。

sentences.en: I mean, I do think we're going to eventually win.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确实认为我们最终会赢。

sentences.en: We can't know.
sentences.zh: 我们无法预知。

sentences.en: We'll probably go to the appellate court in D.C., right?
sentences.zh: 我们可能会去华盛顿特区上诉法院，对吧？

sentences.en: That's the next step.
sentences.zh: 那是下一步。

sentences.en: We don't know how they will rule.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他们会如何裁决。

sentences.en: Will the Supreme Court say, no, we're not going to touch it?
sentences.zh: 最高法院会说，不，我们不打算插手吗？

sentences.en: Or will they take it on?
sentences.zh: 还是会接手此案？

sentences.en: So many ifs.
sentences.zh: 有太多的假设了。

sentences.en: You can't plan on that.
sentences.zh: 你不能以此来进行规划。

sentences.en: You can't plan on ifs.
sentences.zh: 你不能基于种种假设来做计划。

sentences.en: No, we're planning on the tariffs being with us for a while.
sentences.zh: 不，我们做好了关税将持续一段时间的打算。

sentences.en: That's the sad truth of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是令人遗憾的现实。

sentences.en: But we'll still enjoy the win for the time being.
sentences.zh: 但眼下我们还是会先享受这场胜利。

sentences.en: What bottle of wine did you pop open when you found out that you won?
sentences.zh: 得知自己胜诉时，你开的是哪瓶酒？

sentences.en: Well, I was already in the middle of drinking it, but I had no problem finishing the bottle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时已经在喝了，不过把整瓶喝完对我来说完全没问题。

sentences.en: And that was a beautiful Vermentino from Chateau de Roquefort, which is in Aix-en-Provence.
sentences.zh: 那是一款来自罗克福尔酒庄的精美维蒙蒂诺白葡萄酒，位于普罗旺斯艾克斯。

sentences.en: You know, delicious wine.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，非常美味的酒。

sentences.en: Went with my Vongolet and Linguini very nicely.
sentences.zh: 跟我的蛤蜊扁面条非常搭。

sentences.en: My wife and I toasted.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子碰杯庆祝了。

sentences.en: And, you know, there you go.
sentences.zh: 然后，你懂的，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Victor, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 维克托，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Enjoy whatever bottle of wine you pop open tonight.
sentences.zh: 祝你今晚开的任何一瓶酒都喝得开心。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: After the break, I talked to my colleague Gina Smilic about how this case could impact the president's tariff negotiations moving forward.
sentences.zh: 稍事休息后，我将与同事吉娜·斯米利奇探讨这起案件可能如何影响总统未来的关税谈判。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是维纳洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏“同类关联”的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”和“字母连线”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: Gina, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We heard from this wine importer just now who was elated by this trade ruling that came out on Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚听了一位葡萄酒进口商的讲述，他对周三晚间出台的这项贸易裁决欢欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: And I'd like to take a step back here and just understand what was this case about?
sentences.zh: 我想在这里退一步，了解一下这个案件到底是关于什么的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this case was fundamentally about whether President Trump has the authority to enact across-the-board tariffs on U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这个案件根本上是关于特朗普总统是否有权在未经国会批准的情况下对美国贸易伙伴实施全面关税。

sentences.en: trading partners without approval from Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以这是关于对一系列贸易伙伴（包括我所负责报道的欧盟）征收的这10%的关税，

sentences.en: And so it was about this 10% tariff that has been applied to a range of trading partners, including the European Union, which is what I cover,
sentences.zh: 而这显然使得从海外进口产品到美国的成本高昂得多。

sentences.en: and which have obviously made it a lot more expensive to import products from overseas into the United States.
sentences.zh: 而这显然使得从海外进口产品到美国的成本高昂得多。

sentences.en: And so we saw the wine company you talked to, a women's cycling apparel company, an online fishing tackle company,
sentences.zh: 因此我们看到你采访的那家葡萄酒公司、一家女性骑行服公司、一家在线钓鱼具公司，

sentences.en: band together and take this to a court and say that this was an over-interpretation of a pretty obscure law that had allowed these to go into effect in the first place and that it should be overturned.
sentences.zh: 联合起来将此事告上法庭，称这是对一项相当晦涩的法律的过度解读，该法律最初允许了这些关税的生效，因此该法律应当被推翻。

sentences.en: And remind us, Gina, what is that law?
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下，吉娜，那是一部什么法律？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it is this 1977 law called the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, which is what we in trade circles all call IEPA.
sentences.zh: 所以这是1977年的一项法律，被称为《国际紧急经济权力法》，我们在贸易圈子里都称之为IEPA。

sentences.en: And it is basically the cudgel that President Trump has been using to wage his trade war on global trading partners.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是特朗普总统用来对全球贸易伙伴发动贸易战的大棒。

sentences.en: It's not the only thing he uses, but this is the law that he uses to apply tariffs of varying sizes across the board on products from a range of trading partners.
sentences.zh: 这不是他使用的唯一工具，但这就是他用来对一系列贸易伙伴的产品全面征收不同幅度关税的法律。

sentences.en: And so it's been really important to his strategy of kind of surprising people with big, varying, kind of shocking tariff packages.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对于他那种用大额、各异、令人震惊的关税组合来搞得大家措手不及的策略来说非常重要。

sentences.en: This law is a sort of unusual tool to use for something like this because it primarily concerns trade embargoes and economic sanctions.
sentences.zh: 这项法律对于此类事情来说是一种很不寻常的工具，因为它主要涉及贸易禁运和经济制裁。

sentences.en: It was originally conceptualized to be in reaction to national emergencies.
sentences.zh: 它最初构想的初衷是对国家紧急状态做出反应。

sentences.en: And the administration has basically been arguing that the trade situation is a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 而政府基本上一直在辩称，当前的贸易形势就是一场国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: So this is this really unusual interpretation of this 50-year-old piece of legislation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是对这个存在了50年的立法的一种非常不同寻常的解读。

sentences.en: And this wine importer and these other companies basically take it before the court and say, this is too broad.
sentences.zh: 这位葡萄酒进口商和其他几家公司基本上把它带到了法庭上，并表示，这范围太宽泛了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the court that ruled late Wednesday agreed with that assessment.
sentences.zh: 而周三晚些时候做出裁决的法院赞同了这一评估。

sentences.en: Can you just walk me through their decision?
sentences.zh: 你能给我大致讲讲他们的裁决吗？

sentences.en: So the decision essentially said two things.
sentences.zh: 所以这项裁决基本上说明了两点。

sentences.en: It first said that a set of tariffs that the Trump administration has put on Mexico, Canada, and China in response to the fentanyl trade is not a good use of this law.
sentences.zh: 它首先表示，特朗普政府为应对芬太尼贸易而对墨西哥、加拿大和中国实施的一系列关税并不是对该法律的合理使用。

sentences.en: And it also importantly said that across the board tariffs,
sentences.zh: 它还重点指出，全面关税——

sentences.en: these tariffs that apply to everyone at 10 percent currently is too broad of a use of the law and that the law was not meant to give the president unbound authority to just put tariffs on whoever he wants at whatever rate he wants.
sentences.zh: 这些目前适用于所有人的10%的关税——是对法律的过度使用，该法律并非旨在赋予总统不受限制的权力，可以随心所欲地对任何人以任何税率征收关税。

sentences.en: And as a result, they are basically blocking these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们基本上是在阻止这些关税。

sentences.en: You know, this latest news, it only feels like it's adding to this kind of whirlwind of trade news.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这一最新消息让人感觉它只是在给这种乱糟糟的贸易新闻风暴火上浇油。

sentences.en: It's really, I think, been hard for a lot of people to keep all of these different tariffs straight.
sentences.zh: 我认为，对很多人来说，要理清所有这些不同的关税确实很难。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you could just kind of help us understand the current state of play on tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你能帮我们了解一下目前关税的现状。

sentences.en: Like what is in place, where, what's on hold?
sentences.zh: 比如什么在实施中，在哪里，什么被搁置了？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It is a lot to keep track of.
sentences.zh: 需要跟踪的事情确实很多。

sentences.en: I think it's important to emphasize what's not affected, and that is sector-specific tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我认为强调什么没有受到影响是很重要的，那就是针对特定行业的关税。

sentences.en: So you may remember that there are 25 percent tariffs on steel and aluminum and on cars.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能还记得，对钢铁、铝以及汽车征收25%的关税。

sentences.en: Those tariffs are under a different law entirely and are not subject to this ruling.
sentences.zh: 这些关税完全受另一部法律管辖，不受此裁决的约束。

sentences.en: The tariffs that are subject to this ruling are across-the-board tariffs that have applied to a bunch of American trading partners and which were announced early in April on what President Trump called Liberation Day.
sentences.zh: 受此裁决约束的关税是适用于一揽子美国贸易伙伴的全面关税，这些关税是在4月初特朗普总统所谓的“解放日”宣布的。

sentences.en: Those are currently at 10 percent, but they were set to bounce back to higher rates that were specific by country after a 90-day pause, so in mid-July.
sentences.zh: 这些关税目前为10%，但在经过90天的暂停期后（即在7月中旬），它们将回弹到按国家指定的更高税率。

sentences.en: And they've really been sort of the center of negotiations.
sentences.zh: 它们实际上一直是谈判的中心。

sentences.en: This is the thing that Trump is negotiating with countries across the world about.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普与世界各国进行谈判的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, so then the Wednesday night ruling, how does that ruling affect, if it affects,
sentences.zh: 好的，那么周三晚上的裁决，这个裁决是如何影响——如果它有影响的话——

sentences.en: the negotiations that are active right now between the administration and these foreign trading partners?
sentences.zh: 政府与这些外国贸易伙伴目前正在进行的谈判？

sentences.en: Well, this really damages President Trump's ability to do the kind of negotiating that he tends to prefer to do and which he has very much been doing throughout this trade war.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实损害了特朗普总统进行那种他更倾向于进行的、并且在这场贸易战中一直在大量采用的谈判的能力。

sentences.en: So what we've seen him do repeatedly is kind of art of the deal, unpredictable style of negotiation,
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到他一再采用的是那种交易的艺术、不可预测风格的谈判，

sentences.en: where he announces really big tariffs on trading partners and then rapidly takes them off and then threatens them again.
sentences.zh: 即他宣布对贸易伙伴征收非常高的关税，然后迅速取消，接着再次威胁。

sentences.en: And so it's been this sort of, you know, you get a tariff, you get a tariff approach of trying to keep everybody on their back foot.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是“你挨一关税，他挨一关税”的方法，试图让每个人都处于被动防守状态。

sentences.en: And he's been doing that unilaterally, sort of King Trump style, not passing it through Congress, not taking the time to do some big investigation.
sentences.zh: 他一直是以单边主义的方式这样做，有点像懂王风格，不通过国会，也不花时间去做什么宏大的调查。

sentences.en: And he's been able to do it very quickly and very nimbly because of this creative use of this law.
sentences.zh: 由于对这部法律的创造性运用，他一直能够非常迅速且敏捷地做到这一点。

sentences.en: And now suddenly it seems like that might be off the table.
sentences.zh: 而现在突然之间，这似乎变得不可能了。

sentences.en: Although I think it would be premature to say that this is the end of the trade war.
sentences.zh: 尽管我认为现在就说这是贸易战的结束还为时过早。

sentences.en: I've been talking to a lot of people today who are very nervous about what happens next.
sentences.zh: 我今天一直在和很多人交谈，他们对接下来会发生什么感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: I think the word of the day is probably chaos.
sentences.zh: 我想今天的关键词大概就是混乱。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: I think there are a lot of questions about whether there's actually potentially a risk that this actually provokes the Trump administration to do something even more drastic.
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多问题都在讨论，这是否真的存在一种潜在风险，即这实际上会激起特朗普政府采取更加激烈的行动。

sentences.en: And, you know, what would that look like?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Like what options does the administration have in front of it?
sentences.zh: 比如政府面前有什么选项？

sentences.en: So the most obvious option that they have is try to get the ruling overturned.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最明显的选项就是试图推翻这项裁决。

sentences.en: And we've already seen some action there.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到这方面的一些行动了。

sentences.en: They've applied for and then been granted a stay pretty quickly after the ruling.
sentences.zh: 他们在裁决后不久就申请并获得了一项暂缓执行令。

sentences.en: So legally, we're now in this sort of wait and see moment where it's clear that the tariff block is not going to take effect at least immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以在法律上，我们现在处于一种“走着瞧”的时刻，很明显，关税封锁至少不会立即生效。

sentences.en: And it's very clear that the Trump administration is going to really try and get this overturned in court.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显，特朗普政府将真正努力在法庭上推翻这一裁决。

sentences.en: And it could even end up being escalated to the Supreme Court potentially.
sentences.zh: 甚至最终有可能上诉到最高法院。

sentences.en: So clearly there are some legal options here.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然这里有一些法律选项。

sentences.en: And then I think the second bucket of options is what they can do on the trade front.
sentences.zh: 然后我认为第二类选项是他们在贸易方面可以做什么。

sentences.en: And one option there is that they could use another provision in trade law to apply some tariffs up to 15 percent on trading partners for 150 days.
sentences.zh: 其中的一个选项是，他们可以利用贸易法中的另一条款，在150天内对贸易伙伴征收高达15%的关税。

sentences.en: And after that, they'd have to take it to Congress.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，他们必须提交给国会。

sentences.en: But there is a period here where the Trump administration could do that without congressional approval.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一段时期，特朗普政府可以在没有国会批准的情况下这样做。

sentences.en: And how likely is it that the president would enact that 150-day 15 percent tariff and then go to Congress to seek the authority to, I guess, extend it permanently?
sentences.zh: 总统颁布这为期150天、税率为15%的关税，然后寻求国会批准以——我猜——永久延长它的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: I think people think it's possible that he'll do the 150-day version of this.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他会采取这种150天版本的可能性是存在的。

sentences.en: I think people think it's a little less likely that he's going to try to get something through Congress because while that would put this on very solid legal footing,
sentences.zh: 人们认为他试图让某些法案在国会通过的可能性要小一些，因为虽然这会让它有非常坚实的法律基础，

sentences.en: it also means you have to get it through Congress.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着你必须让它在国会通过。

sentences.en: But I think that there are other tools that Trump has at his disposal that he could reach for maybe a little bit more readily that he's used before and which are really legally solid.
sentences.zh: 但我认为特朗普还有其他可以支配的工具，他可能会稍微更轻易地触及这些工具，这些工具他以前用过，而且在法律上非常稳固。

sentences.en: And those are the ones that people are really worried about.
sentences.zh: 而那些正是人们真正担心的事情。

sentences.en: Can you explain that a little bit?
sentences.zh: 你能稍微解释一下吗？

sentences.en: What are these more legally solid options?
sentences.zh: 这些法律上更稳固的选项是什么？

sentences.en: So there are two provisions in trade law that allow you to slap tariffs on trading partners after investigations.
sentences.zh: 贸易法中有两个条款允许在调查后对贸易伙伴加征关税。

sentences.en: One is a national security investigation, and it allows you to apply tariffs to specific sectors.
sentences.zh: 一个是国家安全调查，它允许你对特定行业征收关税。

sentences.en: The other is an investigation into unfair trading practices, and it allows you to apply tariffs to a specific trading partner, so an individual country, but across the board.
sentences.zh: 另一个是不公平贸易做法调查，它允许你对特定的贸易伙伴（即单个国家）但进行全面关税征收。

sentences.en: These are the provisions they're currently using to hit steel and aluminum and to hit cars.
sentences.zh: 这些就是他们目前用来打击钢铁、铝和汽车的条款。

sentences.en: And so this isn't a totally novel idea, which would put tariffs on slightly stronger legal footing.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个完全新颖的想法，这会将关税置于稍微更强有力的法律基础之上。

sentences.en: So if those options could theoretically put the administration on more solid legal footing, why not use those to begin with?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这些选项在理论上可以给政府提供更稳固的法律基础，为什么一开始不使用那些？

sentences.en: Like, why even rely on this 1977 law that seems to have been relatively easily struck down, at least by this first court?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么还要依赖这部1977年的法律呢？它看起来相对容易被推翻，至少被这第一个法院推翻了。

sentences.en: So the 1977 law gives you a lot more unilateral immediate authority.
sentences.zh: 所以1977年的法律赋予了你更多单边的、即时的权力。

sentences.en: It allows you to just kind of throw out a number and threaten another country with it, whereas these investigations take time.
sentences.zh: 它允许你直接抛出一个数字并以此威胁另一个国家，而这些调查则需要时间。

sentences.en: You know, they take weeks, maybe months to complete.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们需要数周甚至数月才能完成。

sentences.en: But what we've seen so far is that the Trump administration has really used a combination of the two.
sentences.zh: 但我们目前看到的是，特朗普政府确实结合使用了这两种方法。

sentences.en: And so they have a bunch of investigations, open, pending, not completed, that would potentially allow them to hit additional sectors with tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有许多公开的、悬而未决的、尚未完成的调查，这些调查可能允许他们对更多的行业征收关税。

sentences.en: And so it's entirely possible that we see more of these sector-specific tariffs and fewer across-the-board tariffs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们完全有可能看到更多的这类特定行业关税，而全面关税则会减少。

sentences.en: And those could still be very painful for America's trading partners.
sentences.zh: 而这些对于美国的贸易伙伴来说仍然可能是非常痛苦的。

sentences.en: It feels as though there has been this pattern since President Trump took office of him levying these huge threats that end up in one way or another going away,
sentences.zh: 感觉自特朗普总统上任以来一直存在这样一种模式：他发出巨大的威胁，最终以某种方式不了了之，

sentences.en: either because a court strikes something down or a deal is negotiated or he walks something back.
sentences.zh: 要么是因为法院否决了某项决定，要么是谈判达成了协议，要么是他收回了某些言论。

sentences.en: And I just wonder if this ruling on Wednesday, if in any way it puts even more pressure on President Trump to show that he means business with these trade negotiations.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，周三的这一裁决是否在任何程度上给特朗普总统施加了更大的压力，以证明他在这些贸易谈判中是认真的。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, this comes at this really crucial moment for the Trump administration because they had been trying to make 90 deals in 90 days,
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，这对特朗普政府来说正值这个至关重要的时刻，因为他们一直试图在90天内达成90项协议，

sentences.en: and they are well short of that target.
sentences.zh: 而他们距离这一目标还差得很远。

sentences.en: And so I think this is sort of entering the ferment at this moment where we're in this really intense period of negotiation,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这有点像在这个正处于高度紧张谈判期的时刻发酵，

sentences.en: and there's a lot of pressure on the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府面临着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: But I don't think it's a foregone conclusion that things are going to get worse from here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为事情会从这里开始恶化并不是一个板上钉钉的结论。

sentences.en: You know, I think we saw stocks rise on this decision because at least people in financial markets think that this could potentially de-escalate the trade war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我们看到股市因为这项裁决而上涨，因为金融市场的人至少认为这可能会使贸易战降级。

sentences.en: But I definitely heard some people voice the concern today that the Trump administration is going to feel like they need to reassert their bargaining position
sentences.zh: 但我确实听到一些人今天表达了这样的担忧，即特朗普政府会觉得他们需要重新确立自己的谈判立场，

sentences.en: and that that feeling of being backed into a corner could force them to take more drastic action
sentences.zh: 而这种被逼入墙角的感觉可能会迫使他们采取更激进的行动，

sentences.en: or could force them to speed up some of these sector-specific tariffs in a way that would really hurt trading partners
sentences.zh: 或者可能会迫使他们以一种真正伤害贸易伙伴的方式加速实施其中一些特定行业的关税，

sentences.en: or in a way that would really hurt companies in some specific countries.
sentences.zh: 或者以一种真正伤害某些特定国家企业的方式。

sentences.en: And so I think there is this concern that you could end up with a deepening of the trade war out of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为存在这样一种担忧，即你可能会因此导致贸易战的深化。

sentences.en: Which is a little ironic because on its face, it seems like this ruling would bring relief, but it sounds like it could actually prompt even more aggressive action potentially.
sentences.zh: 这有点讽刺，因为从表面上看，这项裁决似乎会带来喘息之机，但听起来它实际上可能会引发甚至更具攻击性的潜在行动。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为是这样的。

sentences.en: And I think actually a good example of what that might look like takes place here in the European Union.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这可能是什么样子的一个好例子就发生在欧盟这里。

sentences.en: So where I'm sitting, the EU has been facing a pretty hefty tariff threat from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在我所处的地方，欧盟一直面临来自美国的相当沉重的关税威胁。

sentences.en: President Trump said last week that he was going to slap 50% tariffs on the EU to essentially force it to come to the negotiating table.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统上周表示，他将对欧盟征收50%的关税，以本质上迫使其坐到谈判桌前。

sentences.en: With this court case, it's now unclear whether he'll ultimately be able to use those across-the-board tariffs to try and sort of wrestle the EU into a negotiating position.
sentences.zh: 随着这次诉讼，目前还不清楚他最终是否能够利用那些全面关税，来试图迫使欧盟进入谈判立场。

sentences.en: But even if it turns out that the original decision stands and that he cannot use the 50% tariffs, the EU is not totally out of the woods.
sentences.zh: 但即使最初的裁决维持原判、且他不能使用50%的关税，欧盟也并未完全脱离困境。

sentences.en: But there's still some serious risks that the Trump administration could use other tariffs to kind of force it to bow to the administration's will,
sentences.zh: 不过，特朗普政府仍存在一些严重风险，即利用其他关税来迫使其屈服于政府的意愿，

sentences.en: including sectoral tariffs on things like pharmaceuticals, which are a major export for the EU.
sentences.zh: 包括对药品等领域征收行业关税，这对欧盟来说是一项主要出口产品。

sentences.en: So essentially, the Trump administration might not be able to use this sort of preferred tool of just ratcheting up tariffs,
sentences.zh: 所以从本质上讲，特朗普政府可能无法使用这种提高关税的首选工具，

sentences.en: but it might have other options in its back pocket that could be, if not equally bad, at least very bad for somewhere like the European Union.
sentences.zh: 但它的底牌里可能还有其他选项，即使不那么糟糕，至少对欧盟这样的一方来说也会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And so I think the upshot here is that this is a new chapter in the trade war, but the trade war is definitely not over.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，这里的结论是，这是贸易战的新篇章，但贸易战绝对没有结束。

sentences.en: Gina, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: A federal appeals court on Thursday signaled it would move quickly to address the legal uncertainty surrounding the president's tariffs
sentences.zh: 周四，一个联邦上诉法院表示将迅速行动，以解决围绕总统关税的法律不确定性，

sentences.en: and asked the parties in the case to file legal briefs by early June.
sentences.zh: 并要求案中各方在6月上旬前提交法律简报。

sentences.en: Lawyers for the administration said that they are prepared to take the case to the Supreme Court
sentences.zh: 政府律师表示，如果上诉法院作出对总统不利的裁决，

sentences.en: if the appeals court rules against the president, saying the move would be necessary to, quote, avoid the irreparable national security and economic harms at stake.
sentences.zh: 他们准备将此案上诉至最高法院，并称此举对于“避免涉及的不可挽回的国家安全和经济损害”是必要的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to bar international students from enrolling at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 周四，一名联邦法官阻止了特朗普政府禁止国际学生在哈佛注册的企图。

sentences.en: Over objections from the White House, the judge extended a restraining order that ensures such students can attend the university.
sentences.zh: 不顾白宫的反对，法官延长了一项限制令，以确保此类学生能够就读该大学。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看。

sentences.en: The ruling came on the same day as Harvard's annual commencement, during which its president, Alan Garber, celebrated international students in a pointed jab at President Trump.
sentences.zh: 该裁决正值哈佛大学举行一年一度的毕业典礼之际，典礼上校长艾伦·加伯（Alan Garber）赞扬了国际学生，此举显然是在尖锐地回击特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Members of the class of 2025, from down the street, across the country and around the world,
sentences.zh: 2025届的同学们，来自街区各处、全国各地以及世界各地，

sentences.en: around the world, just as it should be.
sentences.zh: 世界各地，本该如此。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration canceled a nearly $600 million contract with the drugmaker Moderna to develop a vaccine for bird flu.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普政府取消了与制药商莫德纳（Moderna）价值近6亿美元的禽流感疫苗开发合同。

sentences.en: The move was a win for Health and Human Services head Robert F.
sentences.zh: 此举对卫生与公众服务部负责人小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., who has repeatedly questioned the safety of vaccine technology.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）来说是一场胜利，他曾多次对疫苗技术的安全性提出质疑。

sentences.en: Thursday's cancellation also forfeits the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四的取消还放弃了美国

sentences.en: government's right to purchase doses of a vaccine ahead of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 政府在流行病爆发前购买疫苗剂量的权利。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Olivia Natt, Alex Stern, and Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由奥利维亚·纳特（Olivia Natt）、亚历克斯·斯特恩（Alex Stern）和杰西卡·钟（Jessica Chung）制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 节目由马克·乔治（Mark George）和佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Rowan Nemisto.
sentences.zh: 包含罗温·内米斯托（Rowan Nemisto）的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利（Alyssa Moxley）进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰斯伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Susan Beachy.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢苏珊·比奇（Susan Beachy）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《今日》（The Daily）的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·亚伯拉姆斯（Rachel Abrams）。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场痛苦、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》（Metro）节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格（Sarah Koenig）将为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。
